title: What 2,400 retailers taught us about stock-outs
author: Acme Analytics Team
html:
What 2,400 retailers taught us about stock-outs

We analysed 2,400 retailers over 18 months. Stores that reviewed stock cover weekly had 37% fewer stock-outs than those reviewing monthly.

The median store lost 4.2% of revenue to stock-outs in peak season.
